title: 第1章
content_zh:
展有庆说这话时，碧清的月亮，正往影影绰绰的云层里躲，天暗下来，蓝黝黝的。
“天老爷哩，我怎么这么命苦，生个儿子就不管老娘的死活了！”奶奶顺势往地上一坐，支开两条腿，开始干嚎，“为了这个婆娘，你是要把家底子掏空了，把你爹妈都逼死了才能完事呦！有庆啊有庆，你活被婆娘迷了眼啦！”
奶奶飞了口痰，又摔碗，那碗正巧砸在门口石窝子上，碎瓷跳起来，月亮也露出了头，清光一泄，被瓷片折了，竟刺的眼睛疼。
爸爸一声不吭，由着奶奶骂，她看他蹲在石窝子旁，黑魆魆的一团，明明平日里看着很高的一个人，这会儿，渺小的很。她没哭，也没说话，门口过来看热闹的人越来越多，最后，连月光都挤不进来了。
家里羊被人偷了，半夜的事，当时爸在矿里上夜班，妈去追，骑着那辆破摩托，贼没追着，却把自己摔坏了，她伤的很重，又在底下医院耽误了一段时间，挨过了秋天农忙，妈已经生了褥疮。
“啧，腚上烂了那么一大块，可不是快那啥了，他花婶儿，有合适的你给我们有庆留意着！这回可不要俊的，就要能干活的，力气够的！”
“小点声儿，有庆他娘，回头媳妇儿该听见喽！”花婶朝东屋努嘴儿。
“啧，再金贵的腚，这不也生这么大的疮，白瞎了有庆惯着她，这么些年，擦腚都是用的卫生纸，要上天哩，我就说，作狠了天都得收人！”
奶奶的嗓子像是被玉米叶刮过，尖辣辣的，一扬声，东屋里头床上妈妈能听得一清二楚，展颜也听见了，脸上轰的热了下，紧跟着，突然扑簌簌落下两行眼泪，跌在细弱的手腕上--她正给妈翻身。
一九九八年，一九九八年北方的乡村，小卖部卖散称的卫生纸，不够洁净，也不够细腻，但依旧是好人家才能用的东西。
展有庆家里，只有媳妇用卫生纸。用他娘的话说，就是腚比人家长得嫩。
“我不……”展颜哭起来，她扎着马尾，黑油油的一把子头发，又亮又柔顺。
这一年，日子难过的很。哪儿哪儿都难过，夏天发大水，冬天就得死人。那么，城里呢？听书记说，城里人都下岗啦，没了工作，还不如庄稼人哩，庄稼人有地，有地就有口饭吃。
月亮冷了，风刮起来，院子里的塑料盆，捡来的瓶瓶罐罐，全都哗啦啦响个不停。风猛撞窗户，玻璃就跟着发抖，展颜睡在小木床上隐约听见老鼠在大梁上跑，一趟又一趟。
蒙蒙亮时，风把天地都给刮了个干干净净，鸡啊猪啊，都还缩在窝里，没人催着起。
院墙上挂着飘萧的干丝瓜藤，一荡一荡的，锅是冷的，里头什么都没有，只有爷爷坐大门口抽旱烟袋，他往鞋头磕了几下，瞧见展颜，说：
“你爸去县医院了，这往市里头转院不知道啥时候能回来，你这，”他脸黑，说着说着就咳嗽起来了，连皱纹都跟着荡，“等明年小麦一收，就该中考了是不是？”
展颜点点头，她一夜没怎么睡好，脸色有点苍白，两片薄嘴唇倒鲜鲜的，天干物燥，她舔的，又红又疼，快要裂了。
“该念书念书去，家里的事，不要问。”爷爷说完，又把泛黄的烟嘴塞嘴里去了。
锅里没饭，展颜兜里有张五毛的票子，她攥了攥，跑厨房摸了个凉馍馍，馍馍比她的嘴严重--皮儿全裂了。

“吃吃吃，就知道吃，看往后连个馍都没得吃！”奶奶不知从哪儿回来的，一把夺过馍，往笼布上一丢，拽着展颜就往堂屋去。
她才十四，没什么力气，奶奶跟提溜小鸡仔似的，轻而易举就把她给钳制住了，展颜手腕疼，细着嗓子叫：
“想吃馍是不是？钱都被你妈那个短命鬼败坏完了！你还想吃馍？你也往鸡圈猪圈里看看，哪个不张嘴？哪个不等着吃饲料？就你长嘴了要吃馍？”
展颜被搡了一把，肩头那只手，是出了一辈子力气的手，干枯，遒劲，仿佛有着上千年的力道，比古树还古，全都压在此刻了。
content_en:
When Zhan Youqing said this, the clear moon was hiding in the shadowy clouds, and the sky became dark and blue.
"My God, why am I so miserable? If I give birth to a son, I won't care about my life or death!" Grandma sat down on the ground, spread her legs, and began to howl, "For this mother-in-law, you have to empty out the family and force your parents to death to finish the job! Youqing, Youqing, you are so blinded by the mother-in-law!"
Grandma spat and threw the bowl. The bowl happened to hit the stone nest at the door. The broken porcelain jumped up and the moon showed its head. The clear light leaked out and was broken by the porcelain pieces, which stung her eyes.
Dad said nothing and let grandma scold him. She saw him squatting next to the stone nest, a dark mass. He looked like a very tall person on weekdays, but now he looked very small. She didn't cry or speak. More and more people came to watch the excitement at the door. Finally, even the moonlight couldn't squeeze in.
The sheep at home were stolen in the middle of the night. My father was working the night shift in the mine, and my mother went to chase her. She was riding a broken motorcycle. The thief failed to chase her, but she broke herself. She was seriously injured, and she was delayed in the hospital for a while. After the autumn farm work, my mother already suffered from bedsores.
"Tsk, there's such a big piece of rot on the buttocks, it's not that bad. Aunt Hua, if you find someone suitable, let us Youqing keep an eye on it! This time, I don't want a handsome one, I want someone who can work and is strong enough!"
"Keep your voice down, youqing mother, your wife should hear you later!" Aunt Hua pouted towards the east room.
"Tsk, no matter how expensive your butt is, it can't have such a big sore. It's all in vain that Youqing has spoiled her. All these years, she has only used toilet paper to wipe her butt. If she wants to go to heaven, I will say, if she is cruel, the heaven will take her!"
Grandma's throat felt as if it had been scratched by corn leaves. It was sharp and spicy. When she raised her voice, her mother could hear it clearly on the bed in the east room. Zhanyan also heard it. Her face heated up, and then suddenly two lines of tears fell down, falling on her thin wrists - she was turning over for her mother.
In 1998, in the northern countryside, canteens sold loose toilet paper. It was not clean enough and not delicate enough, but it was still something that only good people could use.
In Zhan Youqing's house, only the daughter-in-law uses toilet paper. In his mother's words, her butt is tenderer than other people's.
"I don't..." Zhanyan began to cry. She had a ponytail and a handful of shiny black hair, which was shiny and smooth.
This year, life has been very sad. Everywhere is miserable. Floods occur in summer and people die in winter. So, what about the city? I heard from the secretary that people in the city have been laid off. Without their jobs, they are no better than farmers. Farmers have land, and they have food to eat.
The moon is cold, the wind is blowing, and the plastic pots and bottles and cans in the yard are all rattling incessantly. The wind hit the window violently, causing the glass to tremble. Zhanyan was sleeping on the small wooden bed and could vaguely hear mice running on the beams, one after another.
At dawn, the wind blew away the sky and the earth. The chickens and pigs were still huddled in their nests, and no one urged them to get up.
There were fluttering dry loofah vines hanging on the wall of the courtyard. The pot was cold and there was nothing in it. Only my grandfather was sitting at the gate smoking a pipe. He knocked the toe of his shoe a few times, saw Zhan Yan and said:
"Your dad has gone to the county hospital. He has been transferred to the city. I don't know when he will be back. You..." His face turned dark, and he started coughing as he spoke, and his wrinkles appeared. "When the wheat is harvested next year, it's time to take the high school entrance examination, right?"
Zhanyan nodded. She hadn't slept well all night, and her face was a little pale. Her thin lips were filled with fresh food. The weather was dry and the food was dry. What she licked was red, painful, and about to burst.
"It's time to study and study. Don't ask about family matters." After Grandpa said that, he put the yellowed cigarette holder into his mouth again.
There was no rice in the pot, and Zhanyan had a fifty-cent bill in her pocket. She squeezed it and ran to the kitchen to get a cold steamed bun. The steamed bun was more serious than her mouth - Pi'erAll cracked.
"Eat, eat, eat, you know how to eat. From now on, I won't even be able to eat a steamed bun!" Grandma came back from nowhere. She grabbed the steamed bun, threw it on the cage cloth, and dragged Zhanyan to the main room.
She was only fourteen and had very little strength. Grandma restrained her as easily as if she were carrying a little chicken. She showed pain in her wrists and screamed in a thin voice:
"You want to eat steamed buns, don't you? Your money has been ruined by that short-lived ghost of your mother! You still want to eat steamed buns? Look into the chicken pen and the pig pen. Who doesn't open their mouth? Which one isn't waiting to eat feed? Are you the only one who wants to eat steamed buns because you have a long mouth?"
Zhan Yan was pushed. The hand on his shoulder was a hand that had exerted a lifetime of strength. It was dry and strong, as if it had thousands of years of strength and was older than the ancient tree. It was all pressed at this moment.
